raw_definitions: Definisi : adj 1. very brave, sungguh berani: a ~ struggle, perjuangan yg sungguh berani: a ~ rescue, tindakan menyelamat yg sungguh berani; 2. on a grand scale, besar: ~ enterprise, perusahaan besar; 3. ( of style, language ) muluk-muluk: a speech written in ~ language, ucapan yg ditulis dlm bahasa yg muluk-muluk; 4. ( liter. ) wira: ~ epic, epik wira. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
